title: WRI/Google DeepMind Global Drivers of Forest Loss (1km)
description:
This dataset maps the dominant driver of tree cover loss globally from 2001 to 2025 globally. Produced by the World Resources Institute (WRI) and Google Deepmind. Using satellite imagery and a neural network to classify seven categories: permanent agriculture, hard commodities, shifting cultivation, logging, wildfires, settlements and infrastructure, and other natural disturbances.

Source & citation: Zenodo record 14163025; also on the WRI Data Explorer.
